coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey of collaborative whiteboards and AI diagram tools market, spanning 9 products in scope (Miro, Figma/FigJam, Excalidraw, tldraw, Whimsical, Napkin, Qlerify, Mural, MockFlow) plus extended competitive set (Canva, Microsoft Whiteboard, Conceptboard, draw.io, AFFiNE, Boardmix, Lucidchart/Lucidspark). Sources sweep: (1) Primary capture: official homepages, pricing pages, product launches, funding announcements (T0 basis); (2) Official technical docs: Figma/Miro developer platforms, API specs, changelogs, open-source repos (T1 foundation); (3) Review aggregates: G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Gartner Peer Insights across whiteboard, visual collaboration, and design collaboration categories (T2 authority); (4) Market analysis: Precedence Research, Mordor Intelligence, Verified Market Research market sizing ($3.17B→$9.59B by 2031 CAGR 20%), regional breakdown (North America 37-38% share); (5) Practitioner analysis: 20+ comparison articles (Miro vs FigJam vs Mural, Lucidchart vs Miro, AI diagram tools landscape), use case teardowns, pricing analysis, HCI perspective; (6) Funding/investor data: Crunchbase, Tracxn, Contrary Research on Miro ($17.6B Series C), Figma IPO (July 2025), Lucid ($210M revenue 2024). Deduplication: consolidated multiple pricing reviews into single authoritative sources, merged overlapping comparison articles, grouped analyst reports by firm. Notable gaps deferred: specific SEC filings (public only for Figma post-IPO), paywalled Gartner Magic Quadrant docs, deep-dive HCI research papers (found 1 arxiv reference, user experience primarily addressed via review-aggregate pain-point mentions). Coverage includes T3 listicles and community discussions (HN, Reddit) where they surface novel competitive angles or integration narratives.
